name: secretlink
description: SecretLink monorepo - version source of truth
author: Nicolas BARRAT

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add client/package.json client/package-lock.json server/package.json server/package-lock.json e2e/package.json e2e/package-lock.json
scripts.usine: npm run version:check && npm run db:test:up && npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run db:test:down
scripts.usine:full: npm run usine && npm run e2e:up && npm run test:e2e && npm run e2e:down
